leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open right now — the Suzuki proceeds landed and the balance is comfortably positive. But the recommended move would open one. With all three existing offers plus the ter Horst bid landing, the balance goes negative, and a negative balance at the matchday lock scores zero for the entire matchday. That is survivable and intended, not a reason to skip the bid: the unwind is two sales, both already designated, and it clears back into positive territory with days to spare. The sequencing matters more than the size. Unwind with Sylla and Bernardo, not Sylla and Lokonga — the second pair leaves a defender-heavy shape that fills no legal formation even though the money works. The 33-percent floor is nowhere near binding this run; spending power is not the constraint, the lock deadline is.

binding_gap: The squad is short of the minimum and fills no legal formation, so the empty-slot penalty is already scoring against him. This outranks every value consideration on the board. Three purchases are pending but all three can fail: two are blind auctions that can be outbid and the third is a manager ask the seller can simply ignore. The insurance is explicit — if the squad is still short by midday tomorrow, buy any cheap outfield body at once, and never a second goalkeeper, since only one can ever be fielded and a second one leaves too few outfield players to fill anything.

verdict.detail: Suzuki is sold and the MVP obligation is discharged — but the sale left the squad a body short, so the empty-slot penalty is live right now and no legal formation can be filled. Everything this run points at one action: win a body that also scores. That body is Jano ter Horst, a new Kickbase listing priced at exactly market value, and the auction closes tomorrow morning. Bid the high cluster, well above the median, because this is a blind Kickbase listing and the median is where we lost Campbell and Ebnoutalib. Sell nothing until a buy lands.

sell.reason: Sylla stays first in the queue and the reason has hardened rather than softened: he is the worst scorer in the squad, his value is bleeding daily, and the Club Brugge interest reported this morning can still complete after the German window shuts because the Belgian window runs several days longer. But he cannot go yet — selling him at the current squad size makes the formation problem worse, not better. The trigger is the first buy landing, and then he goes to Kickbase at market value immediately rather than being listed, because there is no longer time to wait for a manager buyer. Bernardo is second: Kickbase carries a knock flag on him from this morning's status update, timed to the Cologne game he came off early in, and his value is falling faster than anyone else's. He is doubtful rather than ruled out — he is not on Ligainsider's injured and suspended table and the last dated club item has him fit — but a doubtful defender whose value is evaporating is the right second sale. Widmer stays last and low priority; he is cheap, benched, and useful as a spare body until the squad is comfortably legal. Lokonga only moves if Eggestein actually lands.

Corroborated by schalketotal 24.08/26.08/27.08 (Schalke needs the transfer millions, price lowered). Dump to Kickbase at mv rather than list: a manager ask clears +3,06% to +4,35% (~280k-400k more) but takes days he does not have, and Keidel just proved the manager route works only when someone wants the player. Sell the moment the allowance exists.

He picked up a knock in the MD1 game at Koeln - that is why he came off at 53 (Ligainsider confirms exactly 1 appearance / 53 minutes in 2026/27), and it was an injury hook, not a Hranac demotion. No club statement yet: Ligainsider's Bernardo profile still ends at 28.08.2026 "Bernardo meldet sich fuer Koeln zurueck" and he is NOT on the Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table, so treat this as doubtful, not ruled out. NOTE THE DATE TRAP that caught an earlier run: the "Bernardo faellt verletzungsbedingt aus" item (Ligainsider 408617 / the TSG tweet naming a Bayern away XI) is 08.02.2026, LAST SEASON - Hoffenheim's MD2 opponent is Dortmund on 2026-09-05T13:30Z, not Bayern. He is now a doubtful starter carrying ap 61 in a fielded XI that cannot be reshuffled at 11 players, and mv 6.547.852 with sdmvt -1.013.483 keeps bleeding ~1M/day. He OVERTAKES Sambi Lokonga (ap 44, fit, starter, mv falling only 190k/day) as the sale to make once Sylla and Suzuki are done: selling Bernardo and keeping Lokonga puts ap 44 into the XI in place of a flagged ap 61 and stops the faster bleed. Sell EARLY if sold at all.

buy.reason: ter Horst is the standout and it is not close. He is a Paderborn centre-back, listed by Kickbase at exactly market value, and he is verified rather than assumed: he started matchday one in a back three, played the full match including stoppage time, kept a clean sheet away from home, carries no status flag, and does not appear on the injured and suspended table. His points return per euro is far ahead of anything else available, roughly triple what the Eggestein offer buys. He also solves two problems with one purchase — he is the missing body and he walks straight into the fielded eleven ahead of both Widmer and the flagged Bernardo. The bid is set deliberately above the highest premium ever measured on a mid-priced player in this league. That is not recklessness, it is the calibration table: contested Kickbase listings here clear in the high cluster, we have now lost three auctions bidding at or near the median, and a rival paid a record premium on this very board today for a player with no points history at all. This is not a reversal of the Vagnoman avoid — it is the same defensive slot filled by a player worth nearly double the points for barely more money. Nothing else on the board earns a bid. The new manager ask on Lukas Ullrich is priced fairly at market value and that is exactly the trap: a fair price on a player who is not scoring is still a bad buy. The rest of the board is unchanged and remains excluded.

Paderborn DEF (tid 29 = Paderborn, NOT Stuttgart - correct an earlier ledger guess). ap 143, the best points-per-euro of any verified starter on this board: 19,9 ap per million of mv against Eggestein 7,3 and Vagnoman 10,5. VERIFIED 31.08: started MD1 in Paderborn's back three of a 3-4-3 at Mainz 29.08.2026 (fussballtransfers lineup: Noll - Hansen, Scheller, ter Horst - Obermair, Castaneda, Ulrich, Curda - Vidovic, Marino, Pieringer), 0:0 clean sheet, Kickbase sec=5731 = the full 95 min, smc=1 ismc=1, st=0 and empty stl, NOT on Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table. mv rising (mvt=1, +370.015 in the last hour). MD2 is Paderborn AT HOME to Freiburg. TWO JOBS AT ONCE: squad is 10 with ZERO legal formations and a live -100, so he is a body AND a points upgrade - he enters the XI ahead of Widmer ap 29 and the flagged Bernardo ap 61, worth roughly +126 ap on the fielded eleven. BID 8.800.000 = +22,19% over mv, deliberately above the +20,96% Campbell high-water mark: this is a contested blind KICKBASE listing, so the HIGH cluster is the benchmark and never the median - we lost Campbell bidding +4,09% into a +20,96% clearing and lost Ebnoutalib twice around +14-21%. Vogt cleared +72,17% on this same board today, so the high cluster is if anything widening. NOT a reversal of the Vagnoman AVOID: same slot, nearly double the points (143 v 73) for 6% more money. AFFORDABILITY: spending power 65.262.032, so the 33% floor is not binding. LEVERAGE: with Nguefack 900k + Maluze 1,2M + Eggestein 16,31M all live, this takes the balance to about -12,26M if everything lands. Unwind is comfortable and MUST be done before the lock - sell Sylla 9,10M + Bernardo 6,55M = +15,64M, leaving about +3,39M and a squad of 12 (1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT) that fields 5-3-2. Do NOT unwind with Sylla+Lokonga: that leaves 6DEF/2MID/2ATT, which fills no legal formation.

German window shuts 01.09 18:00Z, the Belgian window stays open ~4 more days, so an exit can complete AFTER the German deadline. Sylla is squad, ap 21, mv 9.096.588 falling 670k/day, and is funding leg 1. THE TRAP: squad is exactly 11, so sale allowance is ZERO until a buy lands. Georg physically cannot sell Sylla today. The earliest allowance is the Maluze auction at 2026-09-01T11:52Z - and only if it lands. Buying one cheap outfield body creates the allowance now instead of hoping. It was ALREADY the required fix in branches (b), (c) and (d) of the standing plan (3 of 4 branches); the Sylla story just removes the slack that justified deferring it. Kickbase blind auction at mv 714.900: bid the HIGH cluster, 900.000 = +25,9% over mv, absolute overpay risk ~185k. Sequence: bid now -> lands 02:11Z (balance -799k, briefly leveraged) -> SELL Sylla immediately -> +8,3M and squad back to 11 -> Maluze at 11:52Z restores allowance for the mandatory Suzuki sale. Every step stays positive from the Sylla sale onward and the leverage is unwound ~90h before the lock.

killed_this_run.why: REVERSAL of BUY Boleuh6 and RAISE Rf17mrr, both now closed unexecuted (no bid was ever placed - ofc=0 on the listing). The reversal is not about him, it is about the unwind. Cash is 100.941 and live offers on Maluze (1,20M) + Eggestein (16,31M) already put the balance at -17.404.868 if both land. N buys permit exactly N sales, and with 2 buys the ONLY sale pair that clears zero is Lokonga+Sylla (19,73M -> +2,33M); every other pair leaves him negative at the lock = ZERO points for all of MD2. Adding Vagnoman at 8,30M (+19,88% over mv) forces a 3rd sale that must be Bernardo, whose mv is falling ~1M/day, on a margin of ~480k over four days. And the job Vagnoman was bought for is already done cheaper: Maluze ap 184 at 1,20M displaces Widmer ap 29. Vagnoman would only displace Bernardo ap 61 for +12 ap at 8,30M. movers.reason: No flip clears its cost this run. There are no manager asks sitting below market value, so the mechanism that would fund a value trade simply is not present on this board. The one striking price move today was a rival winning a cheap forward at a record premium and instantly relisting him higher — that is a rival trying to recover an overpay, not an opportunity, and it is logged as an avoid. Note the lock is still far enough away that the flip window is open in principle; it is the board, not the clock, that closes it.

fitness.sweep: Bernardo carries a knock flag from this morning's Kickbase status update, described as not coming through the Cologne game unscathed. He is not on Ligainsider's injured and suspended table and the most recent dated club item still has him available, so treat him as doubtful rather than out. Everyone else in the squad is clean. Two date traps were tripped and cleared while checking this run, both worth recording: the widely-circulated Hoffenheim team sheet naming Bernardo as injured is from February and refers to a Bayern away fixture that is not on this season's card, and both prominent Sylla departure stories — the Sky piece and the deadline-day report — are from January and February and concern the New York move that collapsed. The only live Sylla item is this morning's Club Brugge report. On the buy side, ter Horst's start and full ninety were confirmed against a published lineup, not inferred from his points total.
